record.question: Referral and subsequent creation of AVF should be done when eGFR is:
record.explanation: Answer C: <20 ml/min/1.73m2. KDOQI vascular-access planning is individualized; KDIGO suggests planning dialysis access when GFR is <15–20 mL/min/1.73m² or kidney-replacement risk is high. Among options, <20 is the closest conventional threshold. Reference: https://www.kidney.org/sites/default/files/2026-07/2019-kdoqi-guideline-vascular-access.pdf; https://kdigo.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/03/KDIGO-2024-CKD-Guideline.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
